Careers at Lightbits Labs

Join a team dedicated to solving the world’s most complex data infrastructure challenges.

We are looking for great people to join us

What if we could build faster and more efficient data platform, driving down hardware costs, reducing data center energy consumption, and delighting application end users with better performance, security, and high availability?

At Lightbits Labs, this is the goal we work toward every day: faster and more efficient data infrastructure for a sustainable future and delighted end users. Join us in our quest to modernize data centers on a global scale.

Driven by Purpose

Everything we do is guided by our mission to reinvent the way data infrastructure is being done in hyperscale data centers, such as those of Amazon, Facebook, and Microsoft Azure. This is a major undertaking and it’s the reason we’re here.

The right people make all the difference. That’s why we’re looking for those who strive to share their knowledge, contribute their skills, inspire each other and commit to something bigger than themselves.

Customer Obsession

Whatever our role at Lightbits, we have a clear picture of how our actions undertaken that day are helping our customers be more successful and achieving their business objectives.

Excellence

Whatever we do, we do it to the best of our abilities, aiming for excellence and never settling for mediocrity. We demonstrate in our day-to-day work, that anything worth doing, is worth doing well.

Can Do Approach

We foster a “can-do” culture where every member is encouraged to embrace challenges as opportunities, innovate fearlessly, work together as a team, and relentlessly pursue excellence in all endeavors.

Be Part of a Rewarding Journey

At Lightbits Labs, we are on a mission to redefine the modern data center. From pioneering high-performance, disaggregated, software-defined block storage with LightOS to accelerating AI Inference with LightInferra, we build the storage infrastructure that powers some of the world’s most advanced clouds. While our innovation is technical, our foundation is personal. We are committed to an environment where top talent thrives, supported by comprehensive benefits and the resources to excel—both at work and at home. If you’re ready to work with the world’s leading organizations on their next-gen AI and cloud initiatives, your next professional opportunity starts here.
